description.en: An open-ended GT2 (Gates PowerGrip GT, 2MR pitch) timing belt 9 mm wide, cut from long-length belting. A Voron 2.4-class printer hangs its gantry on four of them: each runs from the gantry down round the Z drive's 20-tooth pulley, up over the top-corner 20-tooth idler and back down to the gantry, both ends clamped there.
description.es: Una banda síncrona GT2 (Gates PowerGrip GT, paso 2MR) de extremos abiertos y 9 mm de ancho, cortada de banda en rollo. Una impresora de clase Voron 2.4 cuelga su pórtico de cuatro de ellas: cada una baja del pórtico, rodea la polea de 20 dientes del accionamiento Z, sube por encima de la polea loca de 20 dientes de la esquina superior y vuelve a bajar al pórtico, con ambos extremos sujetos ahí.
description.fr: Une courroie crantée GT2 (Gates PowerGrip GT, pas 2MR) à extrémités ouvertes de 9 mm de large, coupée dans une courroie au mètre. Une imprimante de classe Voron 2.4 suspend son portique à quatre d'entre elles : chacune descend du portique, contourne la poulie à 20 dents de l'entraînement Z, remonte par-dessus le galet à 20 dents du coin supérieur et redescend au portique, les deux extrémités y étant serrées.
description.pt: Uma correia sincronizada GT2 (Gates PowerGrip GT, passo 2MR) de extremidades abertas e 9 mm de largura, cortada de correia em rolo. Uma impressora de classe Voron 2.4 suspende o pórtico em quatro delas: cada uma desce do pórtico, contorna a polia de 20 dentes do acionamento Z, sobe por cima da polia louca de 20 dentes do canto superior e volta a descer ao pórtico, com ambas as extremidades presas aí.

frame_convention: The belt laid straight. Origin at end A's clamp station, on the back face, at mid-width. +x runs along the belt to end B's clamp station at x = length_mm; +y runs across the width (the belt spans y = ±4.5); +z runs from the back face through the belt toward the teeth, whose tips are at z = 1.52. A clamp station is where the belt enters its clamp; the tail inside the clamp is beyond it and not part of length_mm.

height.note: B, the overall belt height, back to tooth tip

voron_350_cut_length.note: the guide's minimum recommended cut length for the 350 spec; the default of length_mm

parameters.note: The default is the guide's minimum cut length for a 350 (source 1); the free length between the clamps is shorter by the clamped tails. The maximum is a 5 m roll (source 2); the minimum is a catalog convention. A belt path computes the length the routing needs.

interfaces.note: Male: the belt end goes into a clamp's jaw. The origin is on the belt's back face at mid-width; the normal points along the belt away from its own length, into the clamp; x_axis runs across the width.

Male: the belt end goes into a clamp's jaw. The origin is on the belt's back face at mid-width; the normal points along the belt away from its own length, into the clamp; x_axis runs across the width. End B is framed for the belt laid straight: in an assembly it is reached through a belt path (ASM-1 §9), not by a rigid mate that would have to close a loop through the pulleys.

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass by an agent (P6-ZBED lane, 2026-10-04); facts read from the cited sources on the access date; no language facet has had a native review.

notes: Belt facts for ASM-1 §9 (lifted into the belt block when that block exists): pitch 2, width 9, height 1.52, tooth_depth 0.76. The pitch-line differential U is not stated by the cited sources, so the teeth-side and back-side offsets are not stated here; the Z belt path runs teeth-on-toothed parts only, which needs neither.
